youtube.description:
Claude Cowork and chat merged into one Claude. Here are 4 changes, rolling out to Pro and Max first.

Claude Cowork and chat merged: 4 changes you will notice. Pro and Max first.

1. One Claude - Claude picks the tool, no more Chat versus Cowork.
2. Background - Longer tasks keep running after you close your laptop.
3. Schedule - Ask for recurring work, like every Monday at 8.
4. Check-Ins - Choose Manual or Auto approval in the message box. Still see both? Not yet.

Needs: Pro and Max, rolling out
